title: Bayern Munich 2026 retro kit leaks - and it’s another classy adidas stunnerShare on FacebookShare on XShare on Reddit
text:
Just when it looked like Bayern Munich had wrapped up their kit line-up for the 2025/26 season – with fresh home, away, third, and the annual Oktoberfest-inspired design already released – another jersey appears to be on the way.

This time it’s something different: a retro-inspired shirt.

Footy Headlines report the yet-to-be-released jersey takes its cues from the club’s identity and its home ground. A bold red-and-blue diamond pattern nods to both Bayern’s crest and the glowing panels of the Allianz Arena’s illuminated exterior. Adding to the throwback feel, the design is finished with adidas’ iconic Trefoil logo.

📸 Bayern 2026 retro shirt, inspired by the club's badge and the Allianz Arena. It will be available late 2025/early 2026 [@Footy_Headlines] pic.twitter.com/cGexf0FTDJ

A subtle “FCB” sign-off sits beneath the collar, giving the piece a bespoke edge. Interestingly, two variations seem to exist – one with a blue collar, the other with a clean white finish – though it’s unclear which will hit the shelves.

The Bayern Munich 2026 retro jersey is expected to launch in late 2025 or early 2026.

And while fans can’t yet get their hands on it, a few things are certain at the Allianz right now: plenty of goals from Harry Kane, a squad already shaping up for silverware, and more kits and merch than Bayern supporters know what to do with.
